title: Quexo's Setspawn
description: Very Simple SetSpawn Plugin For Servers!
body:
💛 **This is Quexo's Setspawn!**
Easily Setup a /Spawn Command for your server!

📒 as an OP, say /setspawn while standing on the place you want to set as spawn.

💎 Players can now do /spawn, and teleport there! [By default theres a 5 Second teleportation Time, And cancels Teleport if you Move!]

🕛 Configure teleportation time in config file, 0 To Fully Remove The Time to Teleport!
